caption: A person on a unicycle stops abruptly, putting a foot down to maintain balance before continuing.
conditions: first frame, caption, existing requirements; no future target
physical_dependency_analysis:
OBSERVED: Rider on unicycle on paved surface, mid-motion, foot off ground, balance maintained via body posture and wheel dynamics.

RESPONSE: Foot placement on ground triggers braking and balance stabilization through friction and center-of-mass adjustment.

PERSISTENCE: Upright stability persists via continuous micro-adjustments of body weight and wheel orientation against gravity.

CHANGE: If surface were uneven, balance persistence would fail, requiring greater body compensation or risking fall.
